name: floating-cell-editor
title: Floating Cell Editor
description: A cell's editor that opens over the cell instead of inside it — anchored at the cell's rect, a little wider and taller than it, with a lock layer that takes presses and scroll behind it while pinch-zoom still passes.

meta.whenToUse: An editor too big for its cell (a long text, a picker, a date) that should open over the cell and keep the cell's own face visible; DataGrid uses it for `editing="floating"`.
meta.whenNotToUse: A pop-up that is not tied to a cell (Popover), or an editor that fits the cell (EditableCell inline).
